items.title: Richard McLean Interview, 1959-05-27
items.q: he happened to come along when Lloyd was playing the bass.

ctx.x: Then after Paul slowed down a little bit, he wasn't doing too much in the music. You see? Then George Williams, he happened to come along when Lloyd was playing the bass. And he wanted me to play with him. So, I played with George Goodwell. I played with George about three years, three years. Longer than that. Then finally here come Paul back again. And that's when you saw me out there on Boydville Street. You see? When I was with Paul. That's when he come back for me the next time. You see? And leaving Paul has…
How long have you been with Bill Matthews now?
